about:
Components Corporation, Inc. is based in Denville, New Jersey. The company was founded by Jerry B. Minter, who served as its president. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the firm has been producing test points for more than 60 years.

The company designs, manufactures, and engineers precision printed circuit test points, wireform interconnect and testing devices, printed circuit card edge connectors, preform jumpers, battery contacts, and related hardware. Its capabilities include custom wireform development, PC mount wireforms, sockets, shunts, headers, fuse clips, and circuit card guides. All parts are produced using proprietary technology and are RoHS and REACH compliant. Products are sold through a worldwide network of distributors and sales representatives.

Components Corporation serves the medical device, security electronics, and industrial electronics sectors, as well as military, aerospace, commercial, and consumer markets. Its customer base includes industrial, military, commercial, and consumer clients who rely on the company for mission-critical applications.

The company states that its differentiation lies in a 'no failure' credo, proprietary manufacturing technology, and a commitment to customer satisfaction through high-quality, innovative products and exemplary service. It also emphasizes its ability to deliver custom wireform solutions tailored to specific requirements.
